text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer continues to accompany Mr. 
C.B. on her walks. She wanders wherever 
her whim takes her, sometimes getting lost 
or not returning until morning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, thanks to that, she was able to 
see many things she never would have 
encountered in her everyday life.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, the Trainer runs into Mr. C.B.'s 
parents. When praising her free-spirited 
nature, the Trainer is thanked for 
respecting her values.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Mr. C.B. told her 
Trainer that she wanted them to see the 
exact same view as her, and suggested 
giving them a piggyback ride while she 
ran.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Scenery rushing past, the wind howling in 
their ears. The Trainer caught a glimpse 
of the view she was seeing. It was a truly 
magnificent experience.
